title: Self-Supervised Learning of Physics-Guided Reconstruction Neural Networks without Fully-Sampled Reference Data
grouping: Three panels marked a., b., c. in bold at the top left. (a) is one iteration in a pale-blue box with a blue outline, labelled 'ith Iteration'. (b) unrolls it: each iteration a pale-yellow box with a blue outline, labelled '1st Iteration' and 'Tth Iteration', an ellipsis between. (c) opens the regulariser in two grey-filled containers with blue outlines, titled in bold above ('ResNet', 'Residual Block (RB)').
shapes_depth: In (a) and (b) R is a flat peach rectangle and DC a flat saturated green rectangle, square-cornered. In (a) they form a loop (R above, DC below, return arrow); in (b) R and DC sit side by side in each frame and a thin grey line from x^(0) runs over the top of the row into every DC. In (c) layers are thick 3-D slabs in perspective with rotated labels: Conv pale blue, RB green, ReLU yellow, xScale red; the residual sum is a small filled blue circle with a white +. Iterates (x^(i), z^(i), x^(T)) are bold italic math on the arrows.
proposed_highlight: Nothing is singled out; the figure explains the unrolled network's parts in order - loop, unrolled row, regulariser internals.
lesson: Draw the iteration three ways in one figure - a single R/DC loop, the unrolled row of framed iterations, then the regulariser's layers as 3-D slabs - keeping R peach and DC green so both carry from the loop into the unrolled copies.
notes: Venue and year as Semantic Scholar lists them (2019 = arXiv year; the journal issue may be later). The paper's self-supervised scheme is its Figure 2; this is the network figure. The figure is embedded in the PDF as one raster image, so photo_share is unknown (null) and the palette is measured over the whole raster. Annotation note (2026-11-15): Figure shows the unrolled network only; the self-supervised data-splitting that is the paper's contribution is not in this crop.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Three lettered panels: (a) one iteration as an R-above-DC loop in a pale-blue box at top left, (b) the unrolled chain of 1st to T-th iterations in pale-yellow boxes at top right, and (c) a full-width bottom row opening the regulariser as two grey containers, ResNet and Residual Block.
insights.data: R is a flat peach rectangle and DC a saturated green one, states x^(i), z^(i) are italic math labels on the arrows, and in (c) layers are thick 3-D perspective slabs (light-blue Conv, green RB, yellow ReLU, red xScale).
insights.emphasis: Repeating the same peach/green R and DC blocks from loop to unroll ties (a) and (b) together, and a grey line from x^(0) over the row into every DC shows the shared measurement input.
insights.flow: Left to right throughout; (a) closes a loop back to x^(i), (b) chains frames with an ellipsis, (c) has long skip lines under the slabs ending in blue circled + signs.
insights.avoid: Panel (c) shows a generic ResNet with no link line back to the R block it expands; draw a zoom connector from R to the ResNet container.

arrangement.units: lettered panels: blue-outlined pale-blue / pale-yellow boxes for iterations, grey-filled blue-outlined containers for the network detail
arrangement.shared: x^(0) feeds every DC block via one grey line
